title: U.S. public UAP / UFO documents
note: Unclassified documents only. Official U.S. releases (local copies). These investigate UAP — they do not confirm extraterrestrial visitors.

documents.title: Preliminary Assessment: Unidentified Aerial Phenomena
documents.summary: First major public ODNI assessment: 144 UAP reports (2004–2021), limited high-quality data, five explanation bins, flight-safety & national-security framing.

documents.title: FY 2023 Consolidated Annual Report on UAP
documents.summary: Joint annual report covering Aug 2022–Apr 2023 reporting; hundreds of new cases; early AARO methodology and domain breakdown.

documents.title: FY 2024 Consolidated Annual Report on UAP
documents.summary: 757 reports received in the period (including backlog); case closures to prosaic objects; public website & reporting mechanism updates.

documents.title: FY 2025 Consolidated Annual Report on UAP
documents.summary: 319 new reports (Jun 2024–May 2025 window + backfill); satellite-flare analysis; Navy maritime swarm case noted as under investigation.

documents.title: Historical Record of U.S. Government Involvement with UAP — Volume I
documents.summary: Review of USG UAP history since 1945. Reports no verifiable evidence of reverse-engineered extraterrestrial technology or secret ET crash-retrieval programs.

documents.title: NASA UAP Independent Study Team Final Report
documents.summary: Civilian science perspective: better data, stigma reduction, and rigorous methods. No evidence found of extraterrestrial technology.

documents.title: DoD Inspector General evaluation related to UAP
documents.summary: Oversight evaluation of DoD policies, coordination, and reporting practices around UAP.

documents.title: Case Resolution: Western United States
documents.summary: Published AARO resolution showing how a reported UAP near restricted airspace was analyzed with sensors and kinematics.

documents.title: Case Resolution: Atmospheric Wakes
documents.summary: Multi-mission Middle East / Mediterranean reports involving apparent propulsion signatures — AARO case write-up.

documents.title: Case Resolution: Southeast Asia Triangles
documents.summary: Triangle-shaped UAP reports from Southeast Asia — official resolution package.

documents.title: AARO Supplement to ORNL Analysis of a Metallic Specimen
documents.summary: AARO comments on Oak Ridge analysis of a metallic specimen claimed by some to be anomalous — materials science, not alien confirmation.

externalOnly.title: ODNI 2022 Annual Report on UAP
externalOnly.summary: Second statutory annual UAP report (not stored locally here). Open the official PDF from ODNI.
